title: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather than Generators
description: BERT masks ~15% of tokens and predicts only them — 85% of tokens contribute nothing to the loss. ELECTRA trains a discriminator to detect whether each token was replaced by a generator, learning from every token simultaneously. Achieves BERT performance with 4× less compute; ELECTRA-Small outperforms GPT on GLUE.
authors: Clark, Luong, Le, Manning (Google Brain / Stanford)
